update.step: CREATE TABLE %PREFIX%_media_markers ( mmk_id integer unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, mmk_uuid varchar(36) NOT NULL, mmk_fil_id integer unsigned, mmk_lnk_id integer unsigned, mmk_position decimal(9,1) unsigned NOT NULL, mmk_name varchar(100) NOT NULL, mmk_is_shared boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, mmk_usr_id_create integer unsigned, mmk_timestamp_create timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, mmk_usr_id_change integer unsigned, mmk_timestamp_change timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (mmk_id), CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_chk_mmk_source CHECK ((mmk_fil_id IS NOT NULL AND mmk_lnk_id IS NULL) OR (mmk_fil_id IS NULL AND mmk_lnk_id IS NOT NULL)) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci

ALTER TABLE %PREFIX%_media_markers ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_mmk_fil FOREIGN KEY (mmk_fil_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_files (fil_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE RESTRICT, ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_mmk_lnk FOREIGN KEY (mmk_lnk_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_links (lnk_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE RESTRICT, ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_mmk_usr_create FOREIGN KEY (mmk_usr_id_create) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_users (usr_id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE RESTRICT, ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_mmk_usr_change FOREIGN KEY (mmk_usr_id_change) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_users (usr_id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE RESTRICT
